featured_philosophical.label: Felsefi öne çıkan görsel
featured_philosophical.description: İnsan odaklı, fotografik, düşündürücü; kalabalık ve yazı yok.
featured_philosophical.prompt:
Create a photographic, cinematic WordPress featured image for the supplied subject.
The composition is human-centred: one person, or at most two, clearly readable as the emotional anchor of the frame.
Avoid crowds, busy backgrounds and competing focal points.
The mood is contemplative and philosophical, inviting thought rather than illustrating a slogan.
Keep a realistic documentary quality. No surrealism, no floating objects, no impossible physics, no dreamlike distortion.
Natural directional light, honest skin tones, shallow but not exaggerated depth of field, 35mm or 50mm perspective.
Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, captions, watermarks, logos or signage anywhere in the image.
If the subject names a specific philosopher, thinker or writer, base the figure on that person's widely known appearance and historical period.

album_cover.label: Şarkı albüm kapağı
album_cover.description: Şarkının diline ve kültürüne göre 16:9 YouTube kapağı; kredi satırı şarkının dilinde.
album_cover.prompt:
Create a cinematic, photographic 16:9 music cover suitable for a YouTube video thumbnail.
Everything in the frame follows the language and cultural world of the song: location, architecture, clothing, instruments, colour palette and light.
A Spanish song reads as Spanish, Andalusian or Mediterranean; an Azerbaijani song reads as Azerbaijani; a Turkish song reads as Turkish. Culture is conveyed through streets, squares, landscape, costume, light and instruments.
Never use religious symbols, mosques, churches, crosses, minarets or any recognisable place of worship.
The composition is human-centred and uncrowded: the main character or the main emotion is immediately legible.
Figures are depicted with dignity and elegance. Clothing stays modest and tasteful; no revealing outfits and no erotic emphasis.
Realistic and emotional, poetic but not surreal.
If a title or credit line is requested, write it in the language of the song and keep it highly readable: large title, smaller credit line, never crowding the image.
Unless stated otherwise the credit is "Söz ve Müzik: Cemal Gürkan Kara" in Turkish, "Letra y música: Cemal Gürkan Kara" in Spanish, "Lyrics and Music: Cemal Gürkan Kara" in English, always matching the language of the lyrics. The song title stays in its original language.

album_cover_thumbnail.label: Albüm kapağı — tıklanma odaklı
album_cover_thumbnail.description: Daha yakın plan, daha yüksek kontrast, büyük okunabilir başlık alanı.
album_cover_thumbnail.prompt:
Create a high-impact 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for the supplied song.
Compared with a standard cover this frame is closer, bolder and higher in contrast, with a clear area reserved for a large, easily readable title.
The title is written in the language of the song and is chosen to attract listeners of that musical tradition.
Cultural atmosphere comes from place, costume, instrument, colour and light. Never use religious symbols or places of worship.
The face or the central emotion dominates the frame; backgrounds stay simple and uncluttered.
Figures are elegant and dignified; clothing stays modest, with no erotic emphasis.
Photographic and realistic, strong colour separation, cinematic lighting, no surrealism.

infographic.label: Dikey infografik
infographic.description: Bilgiyi sadeleştiren, hiyerarşik, kurumsal dikey infografik.
infographic.prompt:
Design a vertical information graphic that simplifies the supplied content rather than reproducing it.
Structure: a short strong headline at the top, a one-sentence summary beneath it, three to six clearly separated information blocks, a data, process or comparison area where the content supports one, and a short closing takeaway.
The most important information sits in the most visible position; supporting detail stays smaller but readable. The eye moves naturally from top to bottom.
Each block is carried by a short heading with a simple icon, number, arrow or box. No long paragraphs; short, precise, concrete statements.
Numeric information becomes a chart, ratio, percentage, counter or timeline. A process becomes numbered steps or a flow. A comparison becomes two columns.
Clean, modern, professional and balanced. Harmonious palette conveying trust and expertise: blue, green, white and grey with orange or yellow as the accent.
At most two typeface impressions. Large confident headline, distinct subheadings, short readable body text, generous whitespace, never cramped.
Professional, plain and reassuring tone. No marketing hype, no clichés, no vague claims.

editorial_article.label: Editoryal makale görseli
editorial_article.description: Haber ve blog yazıları için sade, gerçekçi, konuya bağlı görsel.
editorial_article.prompt:
Create a realistic editorial photograph illustrating the supplied article.
One clear subject, an uncluttered background and natural light. Documentary rather than staged, current rather than nostalgic.
The image should be understandable at thumbnail size and should not depend on text to make sense.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or signage in the frame.
No stock-photo clichés such as handshake close-ups, floating holograms or glowing circuit boards.

corporate_technical.label: Kurumsal / teknik
corporate_technical.description: Denetim, gıda güvenliği, belgelendirme ve teknik içerikler için ölçülü kurumsal görsel.
corporate_technical.prompt:
Create a restrained corporate photograph for a technical, audit or certification subject.
Show a real working environment appropriate to the subject with correct professional clothing and equipment for that setting.
Calm, competent and factual. No exaggerated smiles, no artificial staging, no dramatic lighting.
Neutral palette, clean lines, credible detail, shallow depth of field.
No text, letters, numbers, brand marks, certification logos or watermarks anywhere in the image.
